label: ALPHA_NON_PRODUCTION

methodology.honesty: V1 folder absence is NOT a task to mkdir a second app. Each atom is a live-OS hole (code/UI/API/model/policy/pipeline) or a lock against forking boot/Shell. FinishMode says how to attach it: lock-existing | do-not-fork | adapter | compose-in-shell | unknown-honest | p2-enterprise. 1000 atoms × 10 closable steps (SPEC→GATE) = 10000 WUs. Not a READY score.

contractConflicts: PCT-ROLE-COMPOSITION / REJ-200-APPS — 8 console apps as separate products
ADR-BOOT-001 — any new start-* claiming OS boot
PCT-DESIGN-TOKENS — ui-tokens must not replace design-system palette
UXD-PRO-001 — developer consoles must not become Professional default
